mechanism: Phenytoin induces CYP450 enzymes (CYP2D6, CYP3A4) reducing perphenazine metabolism, while perphenazine may inhibit phenytoin metabolism; additive CNS depression and increased seizure risk due to phenytoin's pro-convulsant effects on dopamine antagonism.
action: Monitor serum phenytoin levels closely and adjust dosing accordingly; assess for reduced antipsychotic efficacy and increased seizure breakthrough; consider alternative antipsychotic with lower interaction potential.
